nom: Mario Badescu Drying Patch Pimple Patches

avis.texte: When you use these patches, are you applying them to a dried wash face or applying them to moisturize face? They will not work on moisturized face, they need a clean, dried serviced..

avis.titre: Don't confuse these with Hydrocolloid patches
avis.texte: These patches work! It's basically their tride and true drying lotion in a bottle. I think a lot of the reviews saying they don't work are expecting the effects of a hydrocolloid patch and that's just not what this is. This patch is formulared with Salicylic acid, hyaluronic acid and Niacinamide. Hydrocolloid is not one of the ingredients therefore this will not pull the gunk out of your pimple like those do. In my opinion, these are better. The salicylic acid dries the pimple, the niacinamide deminishes the redness and the hyaluronic acid helps avoid dryness. You will notice the appearance of your pimple minimizes when you remove it. I put them on over my skin care. However, I would recommend you let your skin care absorb and dry down before putting it on to avoid slipping. They're also shockingly undetectable because they are thin. These absolutely work & they work FAST!
These blend with my skin so well! Definitely my favorite patch & wish they made a microdart version.
this zit patch saved my skin from a really bad zit. it was a nasty one and it took it out in 1 day
People are shocked because they have to try hard to see this on my face. Makes the pimple virtually invisible.

avis.titre: I would rate these negative stars if I could.
avis.texte: These are expensive and do nothing. The Star Face patches are way better and cheaper. I would highly recommed those or the Hero patches. Or literally any other patches besides these. Waste of money.

Ive tried many pimple patches these ones work the best, they actually get rid of the pimple snd stick very well i can sleep without them falling off, although its not very essy to cover up with makeup if your looking to use them during the day. As a teen who has struggled with acne snd still does these are definitely pimple patches i would recommend to anyone.

I was skeptical about these drying patches, but they work incredibly well for me. I have hormonal acne (yay!) and these knock the zits, even the super bumpy ones right down! They stick very well, your skin needs to be clean before applying, as with any zit patch. I often forget I have them on, which is great, because I often forget to take them off before I leave the house! I say, try them, they may work better for you than other brands, as they do for me.
Bought these on a whim because my usual ones were out, they literally do nothing. You're better off just putting a sticker on your face.

I'm a fan of the drying lotion for certain blemishes and love other pimple patches. Took these on a trip because I had a breakout and they did nothing. Wouldn't stay on overnight or during the day and when they did stay on didn't do anything at all for the breakout. I know it would've been gone in no time if I had brought anything else. Don't waste your time or money on these- wouldve given zero stars if possible.

This helped me tremendously for my nodule/cystic pimples. If you have a white head pimple, I would recommend a Hero or hydrocolloid patch. But this is great for those huge nodules or hard nodular pimples! Give it time. Try it at least three times before you decide to move to the next regimen. But i'm telling you, this works to minimize the size

avis.titre: Unfortunately the bad reviews are true…
avis.texte: I decided to give it a try after wearing the mighty patch and this one, literally within an hour the mario badescu did not last and the reviews are true, mighty patch does not do this. I cannot recommend this product.
Mighty patch all day! These dont work and i tried multiple times.

I have used a ton of pimple patches from different brands, high priced to low priced. These are the only ones to do literally nothing. On the only positive side, they've always stuck to my skin just fine. I have given them try after try but they never flatten, nor do they minimize my pimple in the least. I like a lot of their other products, this just isn't one that works (at least not for me).
It did nothing to help. I would recommend any other pimple patch over this brand.

Never in my life have I've gotten an allergic reaction to any skincare products, and I've used many! Went to buy some products last sale and was recommended these by a worker. Should've checked reviews before buying this or any product from this brand cause it gave me my first allergic reaction. I currently have dry red patches all over my face. Keep in mind i bought this, the vitamin c serum and the dew cream from the same brand. Only used the serum once so that wasn't what messed up my face. After days of using the moisturizer, which burned my face after i was trying to use it to help my skin cause it was starting to get dry I realized that the red patches i was getting where near where i had these patches on a couple of times. So lesson learned. Ive always felt uncomfortable w the thought of returning skincare/makeup products but i will definitely be returning this and using the money on something to help get my skin back to normal. For something like this to happen to my naturally oily skin is insane.
These really dont stick at all and do nothing for me personally

I put them on at night and theres always a noticable differnce in the morning. I have sensitive skin, but have always used the drying lotion even though it's a little tough on my face. Shocked at all the reviews saying they dont stay on bc i have to get them off with my nails! Also, these are truly invisible if you want to wear them out.

These are great for use during the day! Sometimes I forget I have them on because they're invisible. They really work to decrease redness and make a blemish disappear sooner. I dont know why they have so many poor reviews.

avis.titre: Just no don't waste your money
avis.texte: These patches did absolutely nothing for me. A total waste of my money.

avis.titre: One of the brands that actually work.
avis.texte: it's honestly hard to find products, especially pimple patches. When I first tried these out I put it on overnight and in the morning when I took it off, all of the gunk was out of the pore. I've used them since and they are amazing.

I've used these on some of the under-the-skin, cystic type breakouts. It has helped either to calm them back down so they go away, or come to a head quicker so they can go away. I found if I use them on any hormonal breakouts I get on my neck, it will cause a red circle which isn't great. Everywhere else it doesn't cause that reaction.
These actually stay on me better than other brands. I do find they truly lift the pimple out and my pimples hurt less after a night of these bad boys.

I absolutely LOVE THESE!! A lot of people are using these as pimple patches and they are not! I found most success using a mighty pimple patch first to get all the gunk out and then using these to help the healing process. My go to stocking stuffer!

avis.titre: keep using it so gotta be good
avis.texte: perfect for day wear bc its literally invisible and it does what it is supposed to do. helps me from picking my pimples also

avis.titre: Would be great if they stayed on
avis.texte: This product definitely needs improvement. Does not have the hydrocolloid effect but does reduce redness if you can get them to stay on. I resorted to taping them on my face bc I didn't want them to go to waste.

These don't do anything. They don't pull oil from pores, they certainly don't pull any gunk from a pimple (open & healing or closed whiteheads). I tried a few at different times and when taking it off it looks exactly like it did when putting it on compared to other brands where you can see the yucky stuff. I got these on sale and still it was a waste of my money.
I dond see any help , also it taker off don't stick to the skin, i don't liked.

I normally use the drylo before my occasional breakouts. Just dot them, but could only do that at night. Now, with these I can put it on during the day. Really prevents my skin from actually breaking out.

I was torn between purchasing this product and another. I chose this brand because of name recognition. I was very disappointed. These patches do little more than mask the blemish. I also purchased the drying lotion, but returned it since the bottle was still 75% full. It, like the patches, did very little as well.

They honestly dont do anything. Theyre good for preventing irritation or infection if you do happen to be a cronic face picker (like myself). They stay on enough id say, definitely lift to some degree though. I did wear them when I wanted a blemish to be blurred throughout the day but didnt want to apply makeup or have a gunky patch on my face in front of people. They didnt actually dry out any of my break outs, though.

I was excited about these because I got them on sale and you get a lot of them! Unfortunately they do not do much for whiteheads, so I won't repurchase. These also don't flatten pimples at all, and they don't stay on very well. The zitsticka, rael, and hero patches are significantly better.

I bought this recently when it was on sale for 50% off just to give it a try. Well I gave it a try and can firmly say this was not worth the price, full price or on sale. My biggest con is that the adhesive is not strong enough to keep the patch in place; it either shifts movement to where it no longer covers the targeted area of treatment or it falls of the skin completely (I apply this to clean, dry skin). Honestly your money is better off going towards the Zitsticka brand patches or even the Mighty Patch brand patches, those I've never had these issues and have always had great results!

These patches are more affordable than other well-known patches, but are far less visible and don't leave red marks after removal. Like many patches, it takes more than 1 application for max results, but the price/qty makes this more manageable than others.
love these patches, they are so thin and stay on so day. i also like that there fragrance free with salisylic acid
I've tried multiple brands of pimple patches and these were the worst because they did absolutely nothing. Save your money and buy another brand

I've tried a zillion brands of pimple patches. So many so nothing (looking at you star face!) and the peace out brand is too strong and leaves red circles on my face. These Mario badescu patches are a godsend. I wear them overnight as spot treatment on my face and body. They stay on and they help my pimples go away in 1-2 uses. Sometimes I'll do 2 nights in a row. Also!!! I wear them out because they kind of work as a coverup for pimples too. Honestly confused how this has such poor reviews.
I love these patches because they really work. I buy them over and over again and always will.
1 on blemish in the morning on cleaned skin and another at night on cleaned and dry skin.. so smooth, stays where you put it and pulls impurities out.. I love it. Will definitely buy again...

I've tried other patches and this one just doesn't seem to do the trick for me. It doesn't dry the pimple or extract the white head out. Disappointed since this was more affordable than the others I have used, was really hoping it would have worked. For now, I'm using it to protect myself from touching the pimple, works great for that. Plus it's transparent so I can wear it all day without getting my pimple more irritated.

avis.titre: Won't be stressed about another breakout
avis.texte: My face broke out bad from stress and the change in the weather. I was searching bad for something to calm my acne down. When you apply the patch it kind of blurs the actual pimple. I feel like the pimple stays clean and protected by weather etc. Depending on the ￼severity of the pimple the patches helped it go down with 1-3days. Overall this should have higher reviews. It works well.

My face was horribly broke out, due to stress/anxiety, and this was the only thing that finally helped! Within 2 days my face already looked a million times better. It even made the spots quit hurting (due to how bad it was). I will 100% buy these again.
Works perfectly, when taking them off the plastic just have to be careful not to rush and press when applying to blemish it can sometimes slip off in the night but that's rate for me at least

avis.titre: It did not do anything for me
avis.texte: Cons: 1) mostly it did not stay on all night or at least moved so the intended area did not get treated. 2) I was overall disappointed with the messy application. Multiple patches are glued to one strip and you have to be careful when taking it off so that your fingers don't get stuck to it which is almost impossible to do. 3) when put on during the day for all day I barely noticed any improvement. Pros: (1) the only positive thing is that it is a very thin and translucent patch that you can wear during the day and it is hardly noticeable- but maybe that is why it doesn't work?
This product did nothing for my pimples on my chest, face or neck. I wouldn't buy these again.

I had high hopes but the only "drying" happening for me was the deprivation of moisturizer I'd otherwise be apply to the area. Starting with the cons because these are a no for me. Cons: little to no redness reduction or minimizing, does little to actually dry zits, and you're probably going to use five at a time due to poor packing Pros: they're very secure and will stay almost anywhere (pesky nostril/edge of lip zits), they're almost unnoticeable on
These do not stick to the face or do anything like the other pimple patches do. I would give 0 stars if I could.
I brought this product to keep in my purse or staying overnight at a friends house. Works great overnight with a different in the blemish in the morning.

The package says to put them on in the morning and leave them on all day, but to not put any makeup on them. But it claims the clear patches are invisible, so it should be okay. Except they're quite noticeable. So you can't wear them if you're going anywhere, which is very inconvenient. And even though I paired them with the drying lotion (pm) as directed, they don't do much. Not worth the money.
You have to dry out the zit with alcohol (normally I would not recommend this) or with a salicylic acid toner before application. Seriously. These have changed my life.

I absolutely love that these have actual ingredients that treat acne. My very stubborn acne was gone with these!! It didnt dry out my skin, stayed on all night, and didn't irritate in anyway. Way better than the hero patches.

They're very thin which is nice for making them not noticeable, but they are also really shiny which draws attention to them… not the best. They also don't do much. I use them to cover pimples during the day but I don't expect it to draw any of the "gunk" out, this definitely will not work like other/better hydrocolloid patches.

avis.titre: Clear stickers that do nothing. Waste your money
avis.texte: I usually buy mighty patch, but my Ulta was out and I figured I'd give this a try. The lady that recommended them said they work great and these are the ones she buys for her daughter. So I thought cool, I bought two boxes cuz I go through them kinda fast between my bf and I. I've used 12, I put some on my bf and some one me. NOTHING. Absolutely nothing happened. It didn't make it go down, nothing came out on the patch, not even seabum or oil like a mighty patch. I was expecting atleast something from the ones I pulled off my bf. NOPE NOTHING. So I bought clear stickers that do nothing. I'm bringing them back Friday for a refund.

I've used other patches brand before, but this one doesn't quite seem to work. I like that it is light, thin and very not noticeable on the face. I normally leave it on for one day and peeled it off to test the effectiveness. It doesn't do much in short period of time. Now I left the patch on at least 2-3 days, it does help the swelling, and redness. When I look at he patch, I could see the white head appearing on my blemish. Normally, when I peeled it off, it does come off with the patch. In this case, it did not. I do not recommend this product. Unless, you're patient and its not a big deal.

I feel like these do nothing. I've had them for over a month and used them on different blemishes, none of these times have they helped. Definitely disappointed & should have gone with something different
This really works it does not burn it does not itch it is soft like a paper towel/toilet paper

This didn't work for me at all. I'm still trying to find the best one and I have tried a couple different brands but this one literally didn't do anything. I honestly didn't see a difference when I used it.

These patches were great. They're clear circles. The perfect small size, couldn't be any smaller. My acne goes away over night or within a couple hours. Only a couple patches outta the whole box fell off.

I would give this 0 stars if I could. Unfortunately I went into Ulta looking for the hero mighty patch and got steered to these instead. I decided to give them a try but they don't stick to your face, and I don't notice any chance in the spots in the morning. They are way overpriced for being such poor quality.
These are terrible. Made my pimples more red and irritated. I've tried other patches and they were better. If you like and are used to the drying lotion which is amazing... This is not the same

I just got this and I have been using i for a couple of days now and it has been working. I like how it is clear and I can just wear it at school and all day and no one can tell. This is my first time using this and I have very sensitive skin and it works fine.

avis.titre: Wanted to love, but I don't
avis.texte: I used to love the drying lotion but hate how fast the bottle would dry out. These just don't work as well and I feel like they cause my pimples to scar more than regular hydrocolloid patches do. They dry up the pimple okay, but not quick enough for the price either. I won't be repurchasing

avis.titre: As good as peace out and better than another brand
avis.texte: I tried this one after trying another brand sold by Ulta which waste a ton of plastic and didn't work. I loved peace out but wanted something kinder to my wallet if possible. This met my needs! My very angry pimple looked so much better the next day. I did a second patch the next night and you can barely tell anything was there. I'm so happy with the product and that MB used the least amount of plastic than all of the other brands that I have tried. MB is becoming my favorite brand.

Love the drying lotion so I thought these would be great...they might be if they would stick to your skin. I have tried several other brands and have had no problem with them staying on all night, Not so much with these. Even after making sure area is clean, dry and free of any oil these will not stay on longer than an hour.

I have been using Mario products for years. I occasionally get a breakout these days from wearing my mask. I have been using the drying lotion and figured give this a shot. The patch drew out the pimple quickly and it worked just fine.
